namespaces.title: Planning
namespaces.description: What Claude is told when it plans your days.

fields.label: Wake time
fields.description: When the planned day starts. Empty = not set.

fields.label: Sleep time
fields.description: When the planned day ends. Empty = not set.

fields.label: Work target per day
fields.description: Minutes of work to plan on a workday.

fields.label: Preferred work windows
fields.description: When work is placed first, as HH:MM-HH:MM.

fields.label: Work tag
fields.description: Tasks and events with this tag count as work time.

fields.label: Office tag
fields.description: Events with this tag mark an office day.

fields.label: Office days per week
fields.description: Empty = no office target.

fields.label: Minimum for an office day
fields.description: Empty = any length counts.

fields.label: Conventions
fields.description: Standing rules every plan should follow, in free text. Sent with every day plan.

fields.label: Assumed travel when nothing is saved
fields.description: Minutes one way for a leg with no saved route. 0 = off.

fields.label: Walk instead of public transport
fields.description: When walking takes at most this many minutes longer.

fields.label: Backlog task is old after
fields.description: The plan warns about undated tasks created longer ago than this.

fields.label: Due tasks ahead
fields.description: Tasks due this many days after the planned range are listed as due too.

fields.label: Open items per study plan
fields.description: How many open items of each active study plan are listed.

fields.label: Assumed task length
fields.description: What a task without an estimate is assumed to take (said in the warnings).

fields.label: Shopping run
fields.description: How long the suggested shopping run takes.

namespaces.title: Reminders & overload
namespaces.description: When tasks escalate to urgent, when you count as overloaded, and the catch-up plan.

fields.label: Tasks due within
fields.description: Tasks due this soon are reminded (overdue ones always are).

fields.label: Events starting within
fields.description: Events starting this soon get a "starting soon" reminder.

fields.label: Overdue tasks
fields.description: Overloaded at this many overdue tasks…

fields.label: Urgent tasks
fields.description: …or this many urgent tasks. Elevated from half.

fields.label: Tasks per message
fields.description: Extra tasks rotate into later messages.

fields.label: Urgent re-remind every
fields.description: Never faster than the normal cadence.

fields.label: High priority
fields.description: Hours overdue before a high-priority task becomes urgent.
fields.group: Escalate overdue tasks to Urgent after

fields.label: Medium priority
fields.description: Hours overdue before a medium-priority task becomes urgent.
fields.group: Escalate overdue tasks to Urgent after

fields.label: Low priority
fields.description: Hours overdue before a low-priority task becomes urgent.
fields.group: Escalate overdue tasks to Urgent after

fields.label: High priority
fields.description: Age of an undated high-priority task before it becomes urgent. 0 = never escalate by age.
fields.group: Escalate undated tasks to Urgent after

fields.label: Medium priority
fields.description: 0 = never escalate by age.
fields.group: Escalate undated tasks to Urgent after

fields.label: Low priority
fields.description: 0 = never escalate by age.
fields.group: Escalate undated tasks to Urgent after

fields.label: Spread: tasks per day
fields.description: At most this many due on one day.

fields.label: Stale after
fields.description: Non-high tasks overdue this long may be dropped.

fields.label: Missed habit after
fields.description: A recurring task missed this many times this week is flagged.

fields.label: Push deadlines / snooze by
fields.description: What the urgency reset (and Resume after a pause) moves deadlines by.

fields.label: Snooze an undated task for
fields.description: How long a snoozed task stays out of age escalation, when no days are given.

namespaces.title: Travel
namespaces.description: Getting to the airport, trip warnings and where trips start.

fields.label: At the airport before departure
fields.description: With the ride there, gives the leave-home time and its reminder.

fields.label: Ride from home to the airport
Visits per day at most
fields.description: More than this on one day of a trip is a warning.

fields.label: Visit length
fields.description: How long a visit's calendar event lasts; two closer than this overlap.

fields.label: Warn about unpaid legs from
fields.description: Days before a trip starts. 0 = never.

fields.label: Time to leave reminder
fields.description: How long before the leave-home time it is sent.

fields.label: Online check-in opens
fields.description: Before a flight; the check-in reminder is sent from then.

fields.label: Tight connection under
fields.description: A connection shorter than this is a warning.

fields.label: Long wait before check-in over
fields.description: Arriving this long before a stay's check-in is a warning.

fields.label: Checklist reminder from
fields.description: Days before a trip, a checklist not generated yet is a warning.

fields.label: Snooze other events during a trip
fields.description: Hold back reminders of calendar events that are not part of the trip while it runs.

fields.label: Rain day from
fields.description: A trip day with at least this much precipitation counts as rainy.

fields.label: Tagged charges from
fields.description: Charges with the trip's tags count from this long before the trip (prepaid bookings).

fields.label: Tagged charges until
fields.description: …and until this long after it.

fields.label: Home
fields.description: Where trips start and the home → airport directions begin: the Home place's address and city.

fields.label: Pre-trip checklist
fields.description: Each item becomes a task when you press "Generate checklist" on a trip, due its days from the trip's start or end (negative = before).

namespaces.title: Briefing
namespaces.description: What the morning briefing covers and how much of each list it spells out.

fields.label: Tasks and events ahead
fields.description: Days the morning briefing covers, today included (also the dashboard's upcoming events).

fields.label: Holidays ahead
fields.description: Public holidays this many days ahead are listed.

fields.label: Tasks due today
fields.description: Spelled out in the morning briefing; the rest are counted.
fields.group: Items listed in the morning briefing

fields.label: Upcoming tasks
fields.group: Items listed in the morning briefing

fields.label: Events today
fields.group: Items listed in the morning briefing

fields.label: Upcoming events
fields.group: Items listed in the morning briefing

fields.label: Shopping items
fields.group: Items listed in the morning briefing

fields.label: Recurring purchases due
fields.group: Items listed in the morning briefing

namespaces.title: Finance
namespaces.description: How the monthly finance cycle is counted.

fields.label: Cycle start day
fields.description: The day of the month your finance cycle starts (e.g. payday). Budgets and monthly totals count from it.

fields.label: Similar past transactions
fields.description: How many past transactions vote on an imported row's category.

fields.label: Similar from
fields.description: Similarity a past transaction needs to vote.

fields.label: Suggest a category from
fields.description: Share of the votes a category needs to be suggested.

fields.label: Active plans at most
fields.description: How many study plans can be active at once, over every subject. A new plan beyond it is refused.

namespaces.title: CS coach
namespaces.description: How weak problem tags are picked.

fields.label: Weak tag needs at least
fields.description: Attempts a tag needs before it can count as weak.

fields.label: Weak below solve rate
fields.description: A tag solved at least this often is never called weak.

namespaces.title: Metrics
namespaces.description: How the metrics stats are computed.

fields.label: Trend window
fields.description: Recent days compared with the same number of days before them.

fields.label: Samples for a reliable group
fields.description: A group with fewer entries is flagged and never ranked best.

namespaces.title: Language
namespaces.description: How language reviews are scheduled, for every track.

fields.label: Requested retention
fields.description: The recall probability review intervals aim for: higher means more reviews, shorter intervals. Only intervals from the next review on change; due dates already set are not recomputed.

fields.label: Leech after
fields.description: A card failed this many times in a row is flagged as a leech.

fields.label: Timed writing task
fields.description: How long a timed writing task lasts.

links.label: Language tracks
links.description: Level, quota and review mode per track.

fields.label: Calendar notifications
fields.description: When each notification profile reminds you before an event, as offsets like 7d, 4h, 30m or 0 (at the start). Events without a profile use normal.

fields.label: Birthday notifications
fields.description: When you are reminded before a contact's birthday, per relationship, as offsets like 1mo, 15d or 1d. Contacts without a relationship use other.

fields.label: Birthdays in the briefing
fields.description: The morning briefing lists birthdays this many days ahead (family and relatives at least 30).

fields.label: Birthdays on the dashboard
fields.description: The dashboard's birthday card looks this many days ahead.

namespaces.title: Weather
namespaces.description: Where the briefing, the dashboard and the weather command look up the weather.

fields.label: Weather place
fields.description: Where the briefing, the dashboard and the weather command look up the weather. A place needs coordinates; a city is found by name. Empty = the Home place.

fields.label: Weather city
fields.description: Set through the weather place.

links.label: Location coordinates
links.description: Set on each location's page; Home's are used when no place is chosen.

namespaces.title: Chat
namespaces.description: Tuning for chat replies, recall, memory extraction and command detection.

fields.label: Messages of history
fields.description: Earlier messages of the conversation sent with each chat reply.

fields.label: Memories per reply
fields.description: Memories, notes and tasks found by meaning and added to the reply's context.

fields.label: Memory match from
fields.description: Similarity a memory needs to be added to the context.

fields.label: Temperature
fields.description: Higher is more varied, lower more predictable. Falls back to LLM_CHAT_TEMPERATURE.

fields.label: Recall match from
fields.description: Similarity a result needs to be returned by recall.

fields.label: Same memory from
fields.description: An extracted memory this similar to an existing one bumps it instead of being added.

fields.label: Importance bump
fields.description: Added to a memory's importance when it comes up again.

fields.label: Command match from
fields.description: An embedding score at or above this runs the command directly. Falls back to INTENT_THRESHOLD.

fields.label: Shortlist from
fields.description: Between this and the command match, the top intents go to the LLM to pick; below it the message is plain chat. Falls back to INTENT_SHORTLIST_FLOOR.

fields.label: Shortlist size
fields.description: Falls back to INTENT_SHORTLIST_K.

fields.label: Your name
fields.description: How the chat and the briefings call you. Empty = "the user".

fields.label: Persona additions
fields.description: Markdown added after the base persona; where they disagree, these win.
